messages.description: Edit AXU4EV-F configuration; Vivado initializes the project from saved config using Tcl.
messages.help: show this help message and exit
messages.lang_help: UI language: auto, zh, en, both; default: AXU4EV_LANG or OS locale
messages.template_help: template directory containing Kconfig and scripts/configure.py
messages.out_help: folder for generated Tcl/C/JSON/dtsi (default: template generated/)
messages.get_help: read one or more configuration values
messages.describe_help: show a symbol's help and dependencies
messages.defconfig_help: load a default profile and save it
messages.generate_help: validate and regenerate files from the configuration
messages.template_missing: Cannot find an AXU4EV-F template. Use --template PATH or AXU4EV_TEMPLATE_ROOT.
messages.pool_alignment: PL_RESERVED_MB must be a multiple of 64 MiB
messages.pool_too_large: PL pool must fit entirely in the high DDR bank
messages.fixed_setting: {name} is fixed by Kconfig and cannot be edited
messages.interactive_json: --json requires a non-interactive command; use list, get or set.
messages.terminal_required: Open the interactive editor in a terminal. For scripts use get/set/list, or --help.
messages.tui_memory: DDR {total} MiB   |   PS {ps} MiB   |   PL {pl} MiB   |   AXI {clock} MHz
messages.tui_dirty: * Unsaved changes — F2 saves configuration and generated files
messages.tui_keys: ↑↓ Select   Enter Open/Edit   Space Toggle   Esc Back   / Search   F1 Help   Ctrl+Z Undo
messages.tui_detail_hint: Enter: open a submenu or edit a value. Space/y/n: switch a flag. F2: save. F3: load a profile. F4: change language. F10: exit. Changes remain in memory until saved.
messages.tui_search_hint: Search symbol names or descriptions in Chinese or English. Esc returns to the menu.
messages.tui_profiles_hint: Enter loads the profile into the editor; F2 saves it. Ctrl+Z undoes the load.
messages.tui_exit_hint: Save writes .config and the generated Tcl/C/JSON/dtsi files. Discard leaves the saved files unchanged.

help.PL_RESERVED_MB: This module has one 4 GiB PS DDR4 and no separate PL DDR. Reserve the top of the physical high DDR bank (0x800000000..0x87fffffff) for PL AXI masters. The low 2 GiB remains available to PS. Generates a Linux reserved-memory fragment and a Vitis memory contract. This is software ownership, not an AXI firewall.
help.PS_UART0: Carrier PS USB serial console through CP2102; UART0 RX/TX use MIO42/43 at 1.8 V, 115200 8N1.
help.PL_UART: AXI UARTLite connects to the carrier CP2102 through a 1.8 V translator. PL UART TX is package pin AB2 and RX is G5.
